contexts.text: We were binding sheaves () = teaching from doctrine. A sheaf = doctrine.
Joseph's sheaf = doctrine from the Lord's Divine truth.
The reason a sheaf = doctrine. Explained. Thus a sheaf in which is the crop = doctrine in which is truth.
To bear sheaves () = the doctrinals of this truth.
My sheaf arose and stood up () = the doctrinal concerning the Lord's Divine Human (reigning).
Your sheaves surrounded () = those in the faith of some charity.
The sheaves, here, = all things of doctrine, or all things of faith. Explained.
And bowed themselves to my sheaf () = adoration of the Divine Human.
A sheaf = a series and collection of such things; for truths are disposed in sheaves.
Wave the sheaf () = vivify the goods of truth.
Each bundle in the body consists of many motor fibres.
The sheaf of the first-fruits = the state (of good) collectively.
The series into which truths (or falsities) are disposed, are signified by sheaves, and bundles. Illustrated.
[Swedenborg footnote 1.] Sheaves = the dispositions into series of the truths and falsities with man; thus also [the dispositions into series] of men in whom are truths and falsities. References.
These make as it were one bundle.
